i.norm: Verifies that {@link JsonTypeInfo.Value#withDefaultImpl(Class)} produces a new, distinct Value: changing the default implementation makes the result unequal to the original EMPTY value (and the inequality holds both ways). The derived value should also keep idVisible as false, inherited from EMPTY.
The new default implementation is not visible (carried over from EMPTY).
The two values differ by defaultImpl, so they are not equal either way.
